We're coming up on our renewal (Dec 15) and want to lock in a plan that covers two things we discussed on the call:

- Move primary hosting for EU traffic to an EU-resident deployment (data residency + DPA amendment)

1) SOW & pricing: attaching a first draft SOW that shows two options (12m, 18m) and an optional APAC burst add-on. Pricing section highlights a committed burst discount when you commit to reserved APAC capacity.

4) Timeline: proposed kickoff week of 12/13, EU migration window 4–6 weeks, APAC pilot staged across two phases (pilot + ramp). See comments in the SOW.

Thanks Ben/Kimberly — quick clarifications from Legal/Procurement: 

- EU residency: Requirement is that patient-identifiable data must remain in-region for primary processing. Read-only failover in APAC is acceptable for short testing windows, but writes must not occur outside EU unless explicitly authorized.
- KMS: we need key residency or bring-your-own-key options documented (who holds keys, rotation, and HSM integration).
- Evidence: procurement requests the SOC2 report (redacted) plus a data flow diagram and the DPA language we can pass to legal.

Attached is our PO template to speed approval (GFH-PO-Template.pdf). We can move quickly on signature once the SOW and DPA language are agreed.

Julia
Director of Product
Greenfield Health
